name: chinese-chess-webxr
description: Xiangqi (Chinese Chess) as a seated WebXR experience for Meta Quest 3 / 3S — play a client-side AI or other humans in passcode-protected rooms, with rated play and an interactive piece tutorial.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ccx/shared && npm run build -w @ccx/ai && npm run build -w @ccx/client && npm run build -w @ccx/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared packages/ai packages/server && tsc -p packages/client --noEmit
scripts.bundle: npm run build && npm run bundle -w @ccx/server
